audit.note: Each language repository carries its own licence. A build manifest must pin the repository revision/file hash and a licence from the allowlist. UniMorph v1 enrichment is used for conservative form-to-lemma evidence; its feature bundle is retained in the local index but is not silently relabelled as UD FEATS.

UD is mixed-licence. Every selected treebank must have its own pinned release/file hashes and an allowed licence. NC, ND and unknown treebanks are rejected. UD supplies UPOS and canonical CoNLL-U FEATS; exact-context evidence is used only when one unambiguous annotation sequence matches the catalogue sentence.
